query: Given this restaurant opening hours string: 12:00 PM - 2:30 PM, 7:00 PM - 10:30 PM, open on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays. Determine if the restaurant is generally open for lunch hours (around 12:00-15:00) on most days. Respond with open_for_lunch True if open during lunch most days, else False.
